$comment: Batch 2 — onboarding. The create ceremony and its sync-failure branch. Both were proven by generator/capture/_probe-onboarding.mjs; this is that probe expressed declaratively, which is the whole point of the driver-level group options (`routes`) landing with this batch: a state that needs a failing network route used to require a hand-written script, i.e. a person at a console.
$safety: `routes` ABORTS every call to the public key index. The ceremony therefore completes locally and NOTHING is written to production — the probe run logged 3 blocked /api/create attempts and zero successes. The parallel-space priming group before it installs the fixed fixture signer, so no device authenticator dialog is raised either.
